questions: Did the party find that the barrow mound's door had recently been opened, based on disturbed dirt beneath it?

Did the goblins concede that Waymon was wise and decide they had outsourced their violence to make themselves feel safe?

Did Dr Uriah put on the robes of Saint Aruthur despite Brother Dirk's objections?
Did Dr Uriah take a quarterstaff from the chest with Saint Arthur's robes?

Did the goblins end up trailing along with the party as they moved to the statue room?

Did the statue room contain a statue representing Piety that was identified as Myrddin?

Did scratching sounds come from the far western end of the corridor off the stairs?

Did Waymon Tisdale offer Ned the dead goblins at the bottom of the stairs, asking whether he accepts bodies he didn't kill?
Did the south room by the stairs contain a pool with living green slime floating on its surface and gold visible at the bottom?

Did Trout take the jeweled chalice from Sir Brandon's tomb?
Did Brother Dirk suggest that the jeweled chalice was meant as a gift for the church?
Did the party earmark the kite shield for Dunk because he was the only one big enough to use it?
Did the party find Sir Brandon's skeleton, dressed in his plate armor and holding his magic sword?
Did Uriah confirm that Sir Brandon's sword was not cursed?
